## Summary

Used the kiranism-shadcn-dashboard skill to learn useDataTable/DataTable/DataTableToolbar since no feature here had used it (0 prior usages). Added the nav item (Finance, Icons.billing, finance.read) and a kbar action ('Record income or spending' -> /dashboard/finance?new=1, auto-opens the create dialog). Fixed two real bugs found along the way: a PostgREST embedded-select broke because board_id has two possible relationships (boards + the agent_board_status view) -- switched to two follow-up lookups; and Intl.NumberFormat's non-breaking space in currency output, normalized to a plain space. 15 new unit tests (bun test: 43/43). tsc/oxlint/build clean, route registered. ## Decisions

- **Dialog forms, not Sheet**: finance.md's original design (written before any code existed) specified Sheet; the actual app has zero Sheet-based forms and five Dialog-based ones (sign-in through invite-user-dialog). Following the real convention over the aspirational doc. (alternatives: Introduce the app's first Sheet-based form)
- **Two follow-up queries for board/category names instead of an embedded PostgREST select**: finance_entries.board_id has two relationships in the generated types (boards and the agent_board_status view), which breaks the embedded-select's type inference when combined with a second joined table in one select string (alternatives: Cast the query result to `any`; Pick one relationship name explicitly in the select hint)
- **Read filter state via the same nuqs keys/parsers the hook creates internally, in the table component itself**: useDataTable hardcodes manualFiltering/manualPagination/manualSorting to true -- it never filters `data` itself, so the caller must fetch already-filtered data; there is no other exposed hook API to read the resulting filter values before the table is constructed (alternatives: Read table.getState().columnFilters via an effect after construction (adds a render round-trip))
- **Static [0, 100,000,000] IDR range bound on the amount slider (marked ponytail)**: No real data yet to derive a bound from; a generous static ceiling is fine until entries exist (alternatives: Derive from getFacetedMinMaxValues())
